fields.originalIssue: E-201 original contract issue: 42 chargers including east bay positions 41 and 42.
fields.revisionNotes.0: Rev F deletes east bay positions 41 and 42. Revised total: 40 chargers.
fields.revisionNotes.1: Owner-approved scope reduction; no replacement chargers or offsetting work. Coordinate remaining circuits with panel schedule.

fields.body: The purchase order acknowledgment still shows 42 chargers. Rev F has been approved and issued to reduce the original 42 to 40. The two omitted east bay chargers have not been installed. We have asked the supplier to confirm the reduced procurement quantity and cancellation terms before recognizing any credit.
